views.name: customer_1998_spending
views.body_sql:
SELECT o.customerid AS customer_id, SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) AS total_spending
FROM orders o
JOIN order_details od ON o.orderid = od.orderid
GROUP BY o.customerid
views.description: total spending per customer derived from 1998 orders, calculated by summing unit price multiplied by quantity while excluding discounts

views.name: spending_group_distribution
views.body_sql:
SELECT 
    t.groupname AS spending_group,
    COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count,
    COUNT(c.customer_id) OVER() AS total_customers
FROM customer_1998_spending c
JOIN customergroupthreshold t 
    ON c.total_spending >= t.rangebottom 
    AND c.total_spending <= t.rangetop
GROUP BY t.groupname
views.description: aggregated counts of customers per predefined spending group, including the total number of qualifying customers to enable percentage calculation
